B) Group purely by problem type (e.g., all performance issues together), ignoring the technology.
C) Create a primary grouping by technology, and then sub-group by problem type within each technology.

A) Keep them fully separate: "UI/Frontend" vs. "Configuration/Admin".
B) Merge them into a broader "Customization" or "Setup" category.
C) Group them under "UI/Frontend" if it involves visual layout or user-facing elements, otherwise "Configuration".

Understood. You will group all network/API calls and cross-system data access (like AJAX redirects or Magento email template data access) under a single "Integration/API" category.

D) Group "Integration Errors" under "UI/Frontend" if they affect user interaction, otherwise "Integration/API".
